title: Adaptive Inference Quality Orchestrator for Quant Profiles
creator: Aisha Patel
description: Goal: Implement an Adaptive Inference Quality Orchestrator (AIQO) that produces unified, per-profile quality signals to drive calibration workflows and rollout gating for FP8/INT8 quantized profiles. AIQO will compute and normalize multiple metrics (perplexity, MMLU-style accuracy suites, ROUGE/BLEU, F1 for QA, task-specific scorers) into a composite score with configurable task weights and an early-warning drift flag. The orchestrator will power: (1) offline validation pipelines used during quant profile generation, (2) automated canary gate checks for rollouts, and (3) an online lightweight scorer for periodic production sampling.
acceptance_criteria: 1) CI job that runs the composite scoring pipeline against canonical datasets: LAMBADA (perplexity), MMLU (multi-task accuracy), CNN/DailyMail (ROUGE), WMT14-en-de (BLEU), SQuAD (F1).
2) Composite score implementation documented and surfaced in the calibration UI with per-metric breakdown and task weights editable in the console.
3) Canary gating rule that rejects quant profile rollouts if composite score degradation > configured threshold or if early-warning drift is triggered.
4) Streaming-aware lightweight scorer deployed to staging which samples 0.1% production traffic and emits time-series for drift detection without exposing raw PII.
5) End-to-end test demonstrating rollback triggered by synthetic degradation injected into INT8 profile.
6) Performance: offline scorer runs full suite within background CI window (<= 90 minutes), lightweight scorer per-sample overhead < 3ms added latency to inference pipeline when sampling enabled.
implementation_notes: Design: build a modular scorer interface: Metric -> Normalizer -> Aggregator. Normalizers convert raw metric units to z-like scores using per-task baselines and variance computed from a golden reference (FP32) pool.

Aggregation: default is weighted average of normalized metrics. We will support task-specific heuristics (e.g., penalize ROUGE drop more for summarization models) and allow override via per-project config in the Console.

Drift detection: implement EWMA + population shift tests on embedding similarity distribution and token-level perplexity deltas. Early-warning flag if either test crosses threshold for N consecutive windows.
Data: use curated, open-source evaluation sets and our internal reference sets. To avoid leakage, internal sets live in secure Drive. Public sets linked for reproducibility.
Privacy: lightweight scorer runs only on sampled requests with PII-stripping pipeline; anonymized signal aggregation for dashboards.
Integration: expose score/time-series to metrics pipeline (Prometheus + Timescale) and Console dashboard; gating service will call scorer API as part of rollout pre-checks.
test_plan: Unit tests for each metric adapter (perplexity, MMLU, ROUGE, BLEU, QA-F1) with synthetic golden and degraded outputs.
Integration test that runs full suite end-to-end in CI against a known FP32 baseline and a test INT8 profile with injected quantization noise.
Load test for lightweight scorer sampling in staging: simulate 5000 r/s with 0.1% sampling and assert <3ms overhead and no increase in tail latency beyond SLA.
Canary test: create a release pipeline that attempts to roll out a bad-int8 profile and assert gating rejects it and triggers automatic rollback hook.

risks_and_mitigations: Risk: composite score may hide per-task regressions when averaged. Mitigation: Console must show per-task deltas and gating rules can require per-task thresholds.
Risk: evaluation runtime may exceed CI windows for very large suites. Mitigation: support prioritized subsets and incremental scoring with cached intermediate results.
Risk: production sampling could leak sensitive data. Mitigation: enforce PII stripping + privacy review and only send aggregated signals to central metrics.
Risk: metric normalization drift if baseline changes. Mitigation: maintain rolling baseline computed from last N full FP32 calibrations and provide manual freeze.
